label: Bible Study
prompt: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and _____ of all.
verse: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
note: The disciples had argued about who was greatest — so Jesus sat down and redefined the word.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The _____ of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
verse: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
note: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD — and He delights in the walk.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Are not Abana and Pharpar, _____ of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
verse: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
note: Naaman was insulted: Damascus had better rivers than the muddy Jordan — why dip in that?

label: Deep Water
prompt: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the _____ of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
verse: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
note: At the second temple's foundation, the young shouted for joy while old men who'd seen Solomon's temple wept.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath _____ gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verse: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
note: Miriam, timbrel in hand, led Israel's women in the victory song at the sea: he 'hath triumphed gloriously.'
